Shubham Saboo氏が提案する「Meta LOOP」は、まさにその理想的な設計図（アーキテクチャ）を示してくれています。

具体的には、3つの役割にモデルを分担させます。
1️⃣ Orchestrator（統括）: 全体の計画立案や指示出しを行う司令塔。高い推論力を持つGPT-5.6などの高性能モデルが担当します。
2️⃣ Advisor（助言）: 戦略的判断や倫理・安全性のチェックを行う相談役。極めて優秀なOpus 5などが適任です。
3️⃣ Worker（実行）: 検索やデータ処理といった実務をこなす実行部隊。Gemini 3.6 Flashのような高速かつ低コストなモデルが大量の作業をスピーディーに捌きます。

この設計の素晴らしいところは、高度な思考が必要な部分だけに高級モデルを使い、単純作業は安価なモデルに任せることで、圧倒的なコスト削減と高精度を両立できる点ですね！💡

大規模言語モデル（LLM）をサクサク動かすためにモデルを軽量化する「量子化」という技術がありますが、「軽くするとどうしてもモデルの頭が少し悪くなってしまう（精度低下）」というジレンマがありました。😭

この技術の凄いところは、単にベンチマークテストのスコアを維持するだけでなく、モデルが次に生成する言葉の確率分布（言葉選びのクセ）まで、元のモデルとほぼ同一に保つ「分布ロスレス」を実現している点です。🧠
これにより、会話の不自然さやエージェント動作でのエラー蓄積を防ぐことができます！

通常、LLMは1単語ずつ順番に言葉を紡いでいきますが、MTPは「次の数単語を同時に予測・生成」して並列処理を行う技術です。特に規則性のあるコード生成などのタスクで、驚くほどの爆速化を実現できるのが魅力ですね！🚀

Four Madison Police Department (MPD) officers allegedly responded to a report of a person checking parked vehicles. The police report says Ruiz fled on a bicycle, and a struggle followed. It then claims Ruiz produced a fixed-blade knife that injured one officer, who then fired three shots. However, Crump stated that bystander footage reviewed by his office shows that the officers appeared to have tased and brought Ruiz to the ground before the shooter opened fire. All four officers have been placed on administrative leave , and the shooting officer has not been publicly identified. Crump called on authorities to preserve and publicly release all footage of the encounter, including squad-car and bystander video. He also called for an examination as to whether deadly force was justified while Ruiz was on the ground. In a press conference with Ruiz’s family , Crump stated that, “People all over America are shocked when they see the execution of Corey Ruiz, because they understand … it was so unnecessary to execute him.” Ruiz’s mother, Elsa Ruiz, visibly shaken, recalled, “My son was an exceptional guy; he was my love. He loved his daughter … [and] his family. title: International Criminal Court votes to remove Chief prosecutor following sexual misconduct allegations
content: The Assembly of States Parties to the International Criminal Court (ICC) voted Friday to remove Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan from office over sexual misconduct allegations from 2024. Khan’s lawyer, Tayab Ali, denounced the vote in a statement. He said that the investigation found no misconduct, including sexual misconduct, against Khan. Ali’s statement also claimed that Khan was not permitted to make submissions and was excluded from the session, and that they would challenge the decision. Khan, a 56-year-old British barrister, had been temporarily removed from his duties in June, pending Friday’s vote. Assembly President Päivi Kaukoranta announced that 82 of the 125 states parties found that Khan committed serious misconduct and a serious breach of duty. Kaukoranta countered Ali’s claims, stating that the assembly fully respected Khan’s due process and that the investigation did find evidence supporting the misconduct allegations. The Assembly’s oversight body commissioned a UN Office of Internal Oversight Services investigation into the allegations, which ran for over a year. It centered on a former aide who said Khan subjected her to non-consensual sexual acts. Khan has consistently denied any wrongdoing. His removal is the first of a sitting chief prosecutor in the court’s 24-year history. The removal comes as the ICC faces significant external pressure, particularly from the United States. Khan issued arrest warrants in 2024 for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant over alleged war crimes in Gaza, along with warrants for Hamas leaders. The Trump administration subsequently sanctioned Khan and other ICC personnel over the warrants. Khan’s dismissal does not affect the cases against Netanyahu and Gallant, because only ICC judges can withdraw warrants.
